full_prompt_en: A square monochrome concept sketch centers a young urban traveler in side profile, standing against nearly blank white paper while checking a small handheld device. The figure wears a close-fitting cap fitted with circular mechanical pieces over the ears, a loose hooded jacket with rolled sleeves, and layered trousers. Dark hair escapes beneath the cap and partly covers the forehead. The head tilts down toward the object, giving the stance a focused, unhurried feeling. A densely packed technical backpack rises behind the shoulder, crowded with cylindrical canisters, clipped cases, cables, a thin upright antenna, buckles, and straps. More small gear hangs from the belt and at the thigh. The body is drawn from cap to upper legs, and the left edge remains open around a few trailing lines. Black and gray pencil or ink marks provide all color; there is no painted backdrop. Thin exploratory construction strokes remain visible around the outer silhouette, while darker crosshatching deepens the folds of the jacket, the equipment, and the underside of the cap. The face and hands receive precise but restrained modeling. Paper white shines through the sketch everywhere, especially around the figure, so the intricate equipment remains clear despite its density. The composition is vertical within the square, with the strongest dark marks around the head and backpack and a gradual loosening toward the lower body. Its character-design energy comes from meticulous observed mechanics held inside a light, unfinished drawing surface.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形单色概念草图把一名年轻城市旅人置于中央侧面，他站在几乎空白的白纸前查看手中小型设备。人物戴着贴头帽，耳旁装有圆形机械部件，穿宽松连帽夹克、卷起的袖子和多层长裤。深发从帽下露出，部分盖住额头。头部低垂朝向物件，使姿态显得专注而从容。肩后升起塞满器材的技术背包，其中密布圆柱容器、扣挂盒、缆线、细直天线、搭扣与绑带。腰带和大腿旁还悬着更多小装备。身体从帽顶画到大腿上部，左边缘在少量拖曳线条周围保持开阔。黑灰铅笔或墨笔痕迹提供全部色彩，没有绘色背景。外轮廓周围仍可见细小探索性结构线，较深的交叉排线则加重夹克皱褶、装备和帽檐下方。面部与手得到精确而克制的塑形。纸白处处穿过草图，尤其在人物周围，因此繁密装备仍然清楚。方形画幅中的构图趋于竖直，最深笔痕集中在头部与背包，向下半身逐渐松开。细致观察的机械结构被保持在轻盈未完成的绘画表面内，形成鲜活的角色设计感。
style_prompt_en: A monochrome concept-art sketch uses fine graphite-like and ink-like lines on clean white paper. Exploratory construction strokes hover around the silhouette, while controlled crosshatching and soft gray smudges build compact tonal masses. Intricate small-scale components gather in a dense focal area, then loosen into sparse marks and generous untouched paper. Edges range from crisp technical contours to faint broken indications. Lighting is understated and largely inferred from white gaps, with darker marks collecting in folds and recesses. The composition carries a vertical visual weight within a square field, balancing careful mechanical detail against an unfinished airy ground. The surface reads as hand-drawn, precise, observant, and lightly provisional.
style_prompt_zh: 单色概念艺术草图在洁净白纸上使用细铅笔般与墨线般笔痕。探索性的结构线飘在外轮廓周围，受控交叉排线与柔和灰色擦痕建立紧凑明暗体量。繁复小尺度构件聚集在密集焦点区域，随后松散成稀疏笔痕和大量未触及纸面。边缘从清晰技术轮廓变化到浅淡断续的暗示。光影克制，主要由白色间隙暗示，深色笔触聚在褶皱与凹处。方形画幅里有竖向视觉重心，以仔细的机械细节平衡未完成的通透底面。表面呈现手绘、精确、善于观察且略带暂定感的气质。
theme_en: A side-profile urban traveler checking a small device
theme_zh: 侧身查看小型设备的城市旅人
name: Kim Jung Gi
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
